name: Star-Struck
baseMeaning: A face with stars for eyes and an excited smile, showing amazement.
tldr: 🤩 adds delighted amazement, impressed praise, or excited overwhelm to the end of a sentence.

contextMeanings.meaning: It expresses delighted overwhelm, especially when something is more exciting than expected.
It can jokingly pretend that an annoying or exhausting situation is wonderful.
contextMeanings.example: i slept three hours and i'm thriving 🤩

contextMeanings.meaning: It can show admiring attention and sometimes carries a playful sense of romantic interest.
It conveys enthusiastic recognition, though its theatrical energy may feel informal in some workplaces.

platformNotes.note: On iMessage, 🤩 works well as the final mark after a complete sentence. Its large face keeps an enthusiastic reaction playful without needing extra words.
In an Instagram comment or direct message, 🤩 turns ordinary praise into an obvious reaction. It can highlight a photo, announcement, or personal update that impressed the sender.
On TikTok, 🤩 fits the fast, exaggerated reactions common in comments and messages. It reads naturally as delighted overwhelm after an unexpected reveal or impressive moment.
In WhatsApp conversations, 🤩 often closes a casual sentence between friends or family. Because it looks dramatic, the surrounding words matter when the reaction could be read as sarcasm.

generationalNotes.note: Gen Z commonly reads 🤩 as delighted overwhelm, alongside 🤯 for shock and 🫶 for excited affection.
Millennials tend to recognize 🤩 as straightforward enthusiasm or admiration, especially when it follows a compliment.
Gen X may take the star-shaped eyes more literally, seeing the emoji as obvious admiration rather than current reaction slang.

warnings.title: The wrong emoji for “please”
warnings.description: 🤩 communicates amazement and excitement, not a gentle request. If the point is “please, with feeling,” 🥺 is much clearer and less likely to seem dismissive.

seoDescription: What does 🤩 mean? It closes a sentence with delighted amazement, impressed praise, or playful excitement, and can suggest romantic interest in dating chats.

longForm.overview:
🤩 is the face people use when a sentence has delivered one reaction better than plain excitement can. Its star-shaped eyes and open smile say, “I am impressed, delighted, or completely overwhelmed by this.” It commonly lands at the end: “that concert was unreal 🤩,” “you did it 🤩,” or “wait, they actually hired you 🤩.” The sentence supplies the subject; 🤩 supplies the emotional temperature.

It sits between 😯 and 🤯 because the feeling is positive rather than shocked. It also differs from 🫶, which can express delighted overwhelm through affection, and from 🥺, which is commonly used for a soft request rather than amazement. In a playful exchange, 🤩 can show that the sender has seen the message and is happy to volley it back. The stars make the reaction theatrical, so people sometimes use it when the praise feels bigger than the thing itself.
longForm.howPeopleUseIt:
Most often, 🤩 appears after something impressive, surprising, or genuinely exciting: a friend’s news, a perfect gift, a stunning photo, or an unexpected invitation. “you booked front row?? 🤩” says more than “cool” without turning the message into a formal compliment. It can also close a realization, such as “you were lying about that recipe 🤩.”

The emoji often follows an expressive sentence like “wait,” “no way,” or “i cannot believe this.” People use it to make their reaction visible and playful. In a group chat, several 🤩 emojis can create the impression of everyone losing their mind together, although one is usually enough to make the same point.
longForm.whenNotToUse:
Do not use 🤩 for an ordinary request when you need someone to take you seriously. “send me the address 🤩” can sound like you are mocking the request or treating it as trivial, so use plain words or 🥺 when you mean “please.” The same advice applies when someone is sharing painful news: excitement can make the message feel disconnected from what they just said.

It can also be too dramatic in a formal workplace or customer conversation. If the praise is sincere but the setting is restrained, write the compliment directly or use a simpler reaction. When sarcasm is possible, add the actual feeling: “three hours of sleep and i’m thriving 🤩” lets the emoji sound intentionally exaggerated.
longForm.howToReply:
If someone sends 🤩, matching the excitement with another 🤩 is the simplest reply. You can also return the feeling in words, such as “i know right?? 🤩,” or escalate the playful exchange with 😎 if you want to sound confident and unbothered. A screenshot of the impressive thing can work when the reaction is clearly about shared content.

If 🤩 lands on your own news or something you made, accept the compliment rather than dismissing it. “thank you 🤩” keeps the exchange warm. When the message is ambiguous, notice the surrounding sentence: “your photo is amazing 🤩” is admiration, while “you’re amazing 🤩” may be more personal. Ask a playful question if you genuinely cannot tell whether the sender is impressed or flirting.

faqs.question: What does 🤩 mean from a guy?
faqs.answer: It usually means he is impressed, excited, or delighted by what you said or shared. In a dating chat, it may also include flirtatious interest, but the surrounding words decide which meaning dominates.

faqs.question: Is 🤩 flirty?
faqs.answer: Sometimes, especially when it follows a compliment about your appearance or something you did for him. It is not automatically romantic, though; it also works as plain amazement between friends.

faqs.question: What does 🤩 mean on TikTok?
faqs.answer: On TikTok, it usually marks delighted overwhelm after an impressive reveal, funny moment, or exciting update. It can look exaggerated in a caption or comment, which is often part of the joke.

faqs.question: How is 🤩 different from 🤯?
faqs.answer: 🤩 is for positive amazement and excitement, while 🤯 is for shock that leaves the sender overwhelmed. Both can express being unable to process something, but 🤩 says the reaction is delighted.

conversationExamples.interpretation: This is admiring attention with a possible flirtatious edge. Reply with a compliment, ask which stylist they used, or playfully ask if they are trying to make you jealous.

conversationExamples.message: we actually got front row seats?? 🤩
conversationExamples.interpretation: The sender is sharing excited disbelief about the group’s good luck. Match it with 🤩, celebrate the news, or send a dramatic reaction about how close you are now.

conversationExamples.message: that pitch was brilliant, i'm taking notes 🤩
conversationExamples.interpretation: This is enthusiastic praise for a successful presentation, though the emoji may feel informal among colleagues. Respond with a specific compliment about the pitch rather than matching the drama blindly.
The sender is genuinely delighted and grateful for the effort. Thank them warmly and mention the dish rather than treating the reaction like a joke.
This expresses amazement at a beautiful view or photo. Reply with awe, share your own reaction, or say where the picture was taken.
